metadata.name: Smoke Login
metadata.description: A split sign-in page. Live WebGL smoke with an acid green thread drifts across a stack of paper on the left and swirls around your pointer; the form sits on plain paper on the right. Opens in dark mode with a light / dark switch, blur-in entrance, Inter.
metadata.author: aakashmehra
